tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.description: List bookmarks, newest first: filter by category, tag, source, or date. A curator may pass status to list pending or rejected ones.

tools.name: get_bookmark
tools.description: Get a bookmark by slug (a former slug resolves too). Public callers see approved bookmarks only; a curator sees any.

tools.name: list_bookmark_tags
tools.description: List bookmark tags, most-used first, with counts and each tag's slug: the tag list_bookmarks filters on, and what a collection's rule names. Returns the top 50 unless limit says otherwise; query keeps the tags whose name or slug contains it. meta.total_count is how many tags matched, and page reads

tools.name: list_pending_bookmarks
tools.description: List pending bookmarks for curation, newest first. Curator only.

tools.name: approve_bookmarks
tools.description: Approve up to 100 bookmarks by slug and publish them. Approving a rejected bookmark restores it. All or nothing: if any slug is not found, nothing changes and the error names the missing slugs. Curator only.

tools.name: reject_bookmarks
tools.description: Reject up to 100 bookmarks by slug, all with the same optional reason; send one call per reason. They stay stored and can be approved later. All or nothing: if any slug is not found, nothing changes and the error names the missing slugs. Curator only.

tools.name: create_bookmark
tools.description: Create a bookmark. It starts pending; approve it to publish. Needs a title and a url or source_url. The slug is derived from the title unless given. Curator only.

tools.name: update_bookmark
tools.description: Change a bookmark's fields; omitted fields keep their value. tag_groups merges by group: a group you send replaces that group, an empty list removes it, and groups you leave out are kept. new_slug renames it, and the old slug keeps resolving. Curator only.

tools.name: delete_bookmark
tools.description: Permanently delete a bookmark and its slug aliases, so its old URLs return 404. Call only after the user has confirmed this exact bookmark by title and slug. To take a bookmark off the site and keep it, use reject_bookmarks. Curator only.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the pages that list bookmarks (YC batches, speedrun cohorts, /startups pages), each with its rule, its copy and how many bookmarks it holds. Public callers see published pages; a curator sees drafts and retired pages too, with status, target_query and a preview_url for each page not yet publish

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Draft a new collection page. It is always a draft, seen only at its preview_url until publish_collection. kind is yc_batch (rule {batch: "Fall 2026"}), speedrun_cohort (rule {batch: "SR008"}), startups (rule {tags: [slug, ...], category?}, any of the tags, or {stage: "series_b", category?}, every ro

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Change a draft collection's rule, copy, controls or target_query; omitted fields keep their value, and an empty string clears a field back to its template. A published page's words and controls are changed in Avo. Curator only.

tools.name: publish_collection
tools.description: Publish a draft collection: it is indexed, sitemapped and announced to search engines. A curator may publish a draft on its own once it passes the gate and its list fits its name; retiring or renaming a live page stays with Tiago. Refused below 10 bookmarks under its rule, for a category or startups

tools.name: newsletter_stats
tools.description: The newsletter's subscriber counts, as totals only: no email address and no single subscriber's row. tools.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to The world according to capital, Tiago's newsletter: the companies VCs just backed, hand-picked by Tiago. Five minutes, every weekday. Call it only with an address its owner asked you to sign up. It sends that address a confirmation link, and the subscription starts only

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_collection" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Draft a new collection page. It is always a draft, seen only at its preview_url until publish_collection. kind is yc_batch (rule {batch: "Fall 2026"}), speedrun…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: subscribe_to_newsletter · Private data: newsletter_stats · Public sink: approve_bookmarks, reject_bookmarks, create_bookmark, update_bookmark, publish_collection, newsletter_stats, subscribe_to_newsletter · Destructive: delete_bookmark.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: subscribe_to_newsletter · Private data: newsletter_stats · Public sink: approve_bookmarks, reject_bookmarks, create_bookmark, update_bookmark, publish_collection, newsletter_stats, subscribe_to_newsletter · Destructive: delete_bookmark

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
